entities.summary: Maximilian Karl Lamoral Graf O'Donnell von Tyrconnell was an Austrian officer and civil servant who became famous when he helped save the life of Emperor Franz Josef I of Austria. O'Donnell was a descendant of the Irish noble dynasty of O'Donnell of Tyrconnell.
